questions.question: Which surface does NOT provide poor traction?
questions.explanation: Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, and painted lane markings all have poor traction. Dry pavement provides good traction for tires.

questions.question: Riding clothes should protect you from all of the following, EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Motorcycle clothing should protect you from sunburn, windburn, rain, dehydration, cold, and injuries from the motorcycle. It also provides extra protection if you crash. It does not specifically protect against chapped lips.

questions.question: The body eliminates one drink per hour. If someone drinks 7 drinks in 3 hours, how many drinks are likely left in their system 3 hours after their last drink?
questions.explanation: To find drinks remaining, subtract the hours since the last drink from total drinks consumed. Example: 7 drinks consumed minus 3 hours of elimination equals 4 drinks remaining in the system.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means proceed with caution. Slow down and check for hazards before entering the intersection.

questions.question: When should you wear reflective clothing?
questions.explanation: You should always wear reflective and bright clothing when riding. Crashes happen day and night, so wear visible clothing anytime you ride.

questions.question: To stop quickly, what should you do?

options.text: Release the throttle and use the front brake
Use both brakes at the same time

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both brakes at the same time
questions.explanation: To stop quickly, use both the front and rear brakes at the same time.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Turn your whole head and shoulders through turns
Keep your knees away from the gas tank
Turn only your head and eyes to look through turns

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn only your head and eyes to look through turns
questions.explanation: When turning, look through the turn by turning only your head. Keep your knees against the gas tank for balance. Your arms should be slightly bent when holding the handlebars.

questions.question: On average, how many alcoholic drinks does the body eliminate per hour?
questions.explanation: The body eliminates about one drink per hour. The time needed varies, so it is safest not to ride after drinking any alcohol.

questions.question: When riding in a group, motorcyclists should:

options.text: Cut their space cushions in half
Keep adequate space cushions around each rider

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep adequate space cushions around each rider
questions.explanation: Even in a group, keep an adequate space cushion around yourself and each other rider.

questions.question: If you wait one hour per drink before riding, what is true?

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and riding
Your riding skills will not be affected
Alcohol side effects may still remain
You will be fine as long as you ride slowly

questions.correctAnswerText: Alcohol side effects may still remain
questions.explanation: Even if you wait one hour per drink, alcohol can still build up in your system. This buildup can still affect your riding ability.

questions.question: What color are warning signs for hazards?
questions.explanation: Hazard warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. Always pay attention to these signs.

questions.question: Where should you ride in your lane when being passed?

options.text: Ride in the center portion of the lane.
Ride in the left portion of the lane.
Ride in the right portion of the lane.
Weave among the three portions of the lane as the vehicle passes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride in the center portion of the lane.
questions.explanation: Ride in the center portion of your lane when being passed. Riding on the side closest to the passing vehicle increases your crash risk. Riding on the far side may cause the other driver to change back into your lane too early.

questions.question: How should you load cargo on a motorcycle?

options.text: Pack heavier items in front of the tank bag.
Pack lighter items near the front.
Try to not place items over the rear axle.
Place items behind the rear axle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pack heavier items in front of the tank bag.
questions.explanation: Pack heavier items in front of the tank bag. Load cargo over or in front of the rear axle. Putting cargo behind the rear axle can make it harder to control your motorcycle.

questions.question: What is a major effect of drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant. It slows down your body and brain functions, affecting both your physical and mental abilities.

questions.question: In New York State outside of New York City, what can you do at a red traffic light?
questions.explanation: In New York State outside of New York City, you can turn right at a red light after making a complete stop. You must yield to pedestrians and oncoming traffic. In New York City, you can only turn right on red if a sign says it is permitted.

questions.question: When do most motorcycle crashes happen?

options.text: After at least an hour of riding.
After more than 8 hours of riding.

questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen on short trips under five miles, just a few minutes after riding starts.

questions.question: What color are signs that show where services are located?

options.text: Blue with white letters or symbols.
Green with white letters or symbols.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blue with white letters or symbols.
questions.explanation: Service signs showing rest areas, gas stations, campgrounds, or hospitals are blue with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: What is the best lane position for a motorcycle?

options.text: There is no single best lane position.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is no single best lane position.
questions.explanation: There is no one best lane position. Change your position as road and traffic conditions change. Choose a position that gives you the most space and makes other drivers see you better.

questions.question: How should a group of motorcyclists ride through a curve?
questions.explanation: Groups should ride in single-file when going through curves, turning, entering a highway, or leaving a highway. Staggered formation is used in other situations.

questions.question: Is the oily center strip of a lane safe for motorcyclists?

options.text: Usually safe, unless the road is wet.
Usually safe, unless it is sunny outside.
Always safe, no matter the weather conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Usually safe, unless the road is wet.
questions.explanation: Oil from cars collects in a strip down the center of the lane. On dry roads, this area has enough grip for safe riding. On wet roads, it becomes slippery. The strip is usually narrow enough that you can ride beside it and still be in the center portion of the lane.
